title: Stir Fry with Grilled Chicken and Tomato
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe with the smoky flavor of grilled chicken, paired with fresh tomato and lightly seasoned with Chinese spices.

ingredients.name: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.notes: Marinate for at least 30 minutes before grilling

instructions: Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into strips.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced tomatoes and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the stir-fry sauce, light soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the wok.
Add the sliced chicken to the wok and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot garnished with sliced green onions.
